description.zh: 需要定制的域名列表。如果不传该参数，默认为账号下的所有域名定制运营报表。
description.en: The domain names for which to customize reports. If you do not specify this parameter, operations reports are customized for all domain names under your account by default.

description.zh: 定制任务的结束时间。使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The end time of the task. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 待定制的报表ID列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。您可以调用[DescribeDcdnSubList](~~270075~~)接口查询报表ID。
description.en: The IDs of the reports to customize. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). Call the [DescribeDcdnSubList](~~270075~~) operation to query report IDs.

description.zh: 定制任务的开始时间。使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start time of the task. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

title.zh: 更新已定制的运营报表

descriptions.en: > The throttling limit for a single user is 3 calls per second.
